t: A pocket-sized classroom computer with lights, sensors, sound, and radio.
steps: Buy a micro:bit V2 Go bundle from a maker shop such as Adafruit or SparkFun.
Plug the board into your computer with the micro-USB cable.
Open the MakeCode editor in a web browser. No install is needed.
Drag a block that shows a heart on the light grid.
Press Download. The editor saves a file you can copy to the board.
Drag the file onto the MICROBIT drive. The heart appears in a few seconds.
Try the shake block next to make the board react to motion.
Explore the Python editor once blocks feel easy.
meta: Open Board. From $16.50. A few stores.
